GFX Final 2023

Question 1- Choose the correct answer [30 Marks]

1. The .......... Degree photos or videos are visuals in which the view in every direction is
captured and presented simultaneously
a) 180 b) 660 c) 360

2. (True /False)? In Room Scale based VR Locomotion, user is teleported immediately to target
location.

a) True b) False
3. The .......... Games are sold to user with a given price. So, user has to pay to play the game
a) Ad-Supported b) Premium c) Free
rr Is essentially the process by which a color is removed from an image. For example:
Green Screens.
a) Chroma Keying b) Normal c) Displacement Vectorization
5. The .......... Refers to when a collection of 2D sprites or layers of sprites are made to move
independently to create a sense of added depth (simulated Z-depth)
a) Crowd-Sourcing b) Parallax scrolling c) Augmented Reality
6. The length of .......... Vector is always one unit.
a) Normalized b) Rotated c) Sheared
7. In game loop, the .......... Phase is responsible for detecting input from user (such as
keyboard and mouse).
a) Updating world b) Generating Output c) Processing Input

8. The map is useful to create large 2D scenes that contain repeatable drawing patterns
(shapes)
a) Tile b) Name c) Vector

9. In the following tileset:

a) [1, 4, 3, 4] b) [1, 3, 4, 4] c) [0, 3, 4]

10. In the previous tileset, what is the output of the following matrix [2, 0, 0, 1, 2]?

11. In isometric projection, the angle between each axis is ..........
a) 100 b) 120 c) 150

12. The .......... Is the part of the animation software that represents the animation’s progress
over time

a) TimeLine b) FrameLine c) Working on Two’s
13. The magnetic motion capture uses .......... Placed on an actor’s body that measure
magnetic fields created by a transmitter

a) Colors b) Sensors c) Clays
14. The rule of .......... Is a method of breaking up an image or design into different sections
using columns and rows that form a grid

a) Thirds b) One’s c) Electro-mechanical
15. In three point lighting theory, the fill light has .......... Light intensity of key light.

a) Same b) Twice c) Half

16. A tilt is a rotation of the camera
a) Vertically b) Horizontally c) Randomly

17. The 3D .......... Face has only 4 vertices.
a) Triangle b) Quad c) N-GON

18. The .......... Modeling uses the operations of : union, intersection and difference to change
the geometry of shape
a) Primitive b) Laser c) Boolean

19. In UV mapping, the U and V range from 0 to ..........
a) 1 b)2 c) 1000

20. .......... Map uses RGB values to control the surface normal components (X,Y,Z) and make
fake depth
a) Bump b) Displacement c) Normal

Question 2- Choose the correct answer [30 Marks]

1. When an object's position is calculated according to the position of another object is called

a) Relative position b) Absolute position c) Fixed position
2. The size of an 8 bit depth image is .......... The size of 24 bit
a) One-fourth b) One-third c) Two-thirds

3. When the image contains large areas of uniform color, it is recommended to use..........
a) BMP b) GIF c) JPEG

4. In additive color models, mixing two colors results ina ..........
a) Same color b) Darker color c) Brighter color

5. The subset of colors which can be accurately represented within a given color space or by a
certain output device is called ..........
a) Color harmony b) GAMUT c) Both

6. Saturation ranges from 0 to 100%. When the saturation is 0, the coloris ...........
a) Grey b) Primary color c) Faded color

7. In harmony schemes, if we choose three colors which lie close together on a color wheel.
This is called .................
a) Monochromatic b) Complementary c) Analogous

8B. eee Is created by adding black to base hue
a) Shade b) Tint c) Tone

9. A rigid body transformation that moves objects without deformation is called ..........
a) Translation b) Scaling c) Shear

10. In some systems, negative values can be specified for the scaling parameters, this is not
only resizing. It also results in ..........
a) Rotation b) Reflection c) Shear

11. A reflection about the line x = 0 (the y-axis) flips .......... Coordinates while keeping
coordinates the same.
a)Y,X b)X,Y c)X,X

12. A transformation that distorts the shape of an object layer that had been caused to slide
over each other is called ................
a) Reflection b) Shear c) Rotation

13. The need to compress media data is motivated by ........
a) Storage requirements b) Transmission requirements c) Both d) None

14. (True/False)? Compression can be considered as a science

a) True b) False
15. ee Occurs when the image sample density exceeds the limits of visual acuity
a) Virtual irrelevancy b) Application-specific irrelevance c) Both d) None

16. (True/False)? The image signal has statistical redundancy
a) True b) False

17. (True/False)? Entropy represents the average amount of information contained per symbol
in the source S
a) True b) False

18. Given a picture that has an equal distribution of black and white pixels. Here, P1 and P2 are
both roughly 0.5 and His..........
a) 0 b) 1 c)2 d)4

19. (True/False)? LZW uses fixed-length codewords to represent variable-length strings of
symbols/characters that commonly occur together
a) True b) False

20. (True/False)? Computer vision is concerned with the theory for building artificial systems
that obtain information from images
a) True b) False
